name: Chip
title: Chip
summary: A pill toggle (`.chip` with `aria-pressed`) for filtering a list or picking a preset value such as a gift amount.
whenToUse: Use to filter content in place: resources by topic, languages, programs.
Use for amount presets on Give ($25, $50, $100, Other).
whenNotToUse: Do not use for actions that go somewhere; use Button or Link.
Do not use for status labels; use Badge. For a removable applied filter, use the tag in Badge.

anatomy.description: A 44px pill with a 1px `rgba(0,0,0,.28)` border and a 15px semibold label. Pressed = solid black with white text.
anatomy.markup: Lay chips out with `display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:8px` (`--space-2`).

props.name: pressed
props.description: Whether the chip is on. Renders `aria-pressed`.

props.name: children
props.description: Short text label, one or two words. Text only: no icons or flags.

react.notes: `import { Chip, ChipGroup } from '@ism/ui'`. `ChipGroup` renders the `role="group"` with an 8px gap and manages pressed state: `options` (`{ value, label, disabled }[]`), `mode` `"single" | "multiple"` (default `"single"`), `value` / `defaultValue`, `onChange`, and a required `aria-label`.

props.name: children
props.description: One or two words, sentence case ("All", "Amharic", "$50"). Text only: no icons, flags or emoji.

props.name: selected
props.description: Pressed (on) state, reported as selected. Pressed chips are black (white on dark), never Horizon Blue.

variantNotes: Focus: shared focus ring (2px Horizon Blue + `--shadow-focus`).
Single-choice group (filters with "All", amount presets): pressing one releases the others.
Multi-choice group (languages): each chip toggles on its own.

states.universal: See rules/states.md for the seven required states and their hooks.

rules: Pressed chips are black, never Horizon Blue; blue stays reserved for the one primary button.
A single-choice filter always starts with "All" pressed.
Amount presets: three amounts plus "Other", with the middle amount pressed by default; "Other" reveals the amount field (see Input).
Keep chips text only: no icons, flags or emoji.
do: Use to filter content in place: resources by topic, languages, programs.
Use for amount presets on Give ($25, $50, $100, Other).
Pressed chips are black, never Horizon Blue; blue stays reserved for the one primary button.
A single-choice filter always starts with "All" pressed.
Amount presets: three amounts plus "Other", with the middle amount pressed by default; "Other" reveals the amount field (see Input).
Keep chips text only: no icons, flags or emoji.
dont: Do not use for actions that go somewhere; use Button or Link.
Do not use for status labels; use Badge. For a removable applied filter, use the tag in Badge.
accessibility: Use `<button type="button">` with `aria-pressed`; wrap the set in `role="group"` with an `aria-label`.
Filter results must update a live region or the visible count so screen-reader users hear the change.
Colour is not the only signal: pressed chips invert fill and text.
content: One or two words, sentence case: "All", "About ISM", "Apps", "Giving", "HD Radio".
Amounts show the currency symbol and no decimals: "$50". Amounts shown are samples.

react:
<ChipGroup aria-label="Filter resources" defaultValue="all" onChange={setTopic}
  options={[{ value: 'all', label: 'All' }, { value: 'about', label: 'About ISM' }, { value: 'apps', label: 'Apps' }]} />
<Chip pressed={on} onClick={toggle}>Amharic</Chip>
